By train or bus

Get off at Neutram 's "Trade Center Front Station" and arrive at sunflower terminal (osaka) Terminal1 in about 5 minutes on foot from the station - connected aisle.
After taking the boarding procedure at Terminal 1, we will pick you up from the elevator building to the Terminal 2 with a free shuttle bus. (Walking between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 is dangerous, please refrain.)

From Kansai International Airport

Take the limousine bus bound for Osaka Nanko and get off at "Hyatt Regency Osaka".
Please click here for timetable.
From there you will arrive at the Terminal１ in 10 minutes on foot. we will pick you up from the elevator building to the Terminal 2 with a free shuttle bus.

From Itami Domestic Airport

Go to "Namba" by limousine bus. Please click here for timetable.
Transfer to Midosuji subway line and get off at "Honmachi" station. From there transfer to Chuo subway line and take the train to "Cosmosquare" station. Transfer to Newtram line and take the newtram to "Trade Center" station. From there you will arrive at the Terminal１ in 5 minutes on foot. we will pick you up from the elevator building to the Terminal 2 with a free shuttle bus.

By car

From Osaka City

Take the "Nanko Kita" exit on the Hanshin Expressway Wangan Line. The terminal is a 15-minute drive away.

From Kansai International Airport

Take the "Nanko Minami" exit on the Hanshin Expressway Wangan Line.The terminal is a 20-minute drive away.
